changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO price_lists (id, operator_id, template, currency, insurance_percent, vat_percent, updated_at) SELECT 1000 + row_number() OVER (ORDER BY o.operator_id), o.operator_id, false, t.currency, t.insurance_percent, t.vat_percent, now() FROM operators o CROSS JOIN price_lists t WHERE t.template = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM price_lists existing WHERE existing.operator_id = o.operator_id); INSERT INTO price_list_size_classes (price_list_id, position, code, max_length_cm, max_width_cm, max_height_cm, net_price) SELECT c.id, s.position, s.code, s.max_length_cm, s.max_width_cm, s.max_height_cm, s.net_price FROM price_lists c JOIN price_lists t ON t.template = true JOIN price_list_size_classes s ON s.price_list_id = t.id WHERE c.template = false AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM price_list_size_classes x WHERE x.price_list_id = c.id); INSERT INTO price_list_weight_bands (price_list_id, position, from_kg, to_kg, net_surcharge) SELECT c.id, w.position, w.from_kg, w.to_kg, w.net_surcharge FROM price_lists c JOIN price_lists t ON t.template = true JOIN price_list_weight_bands w ON w.price_list_id = t.id WHERE c.template = false AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM price_list_weight_bands x WHERE x.price_list_id = c.id); INSERT INTO price_list_service_levels (price_list_id, service_level, multiplier) SELECT c.id, s.service_level, s.multiplier FROM price_lists c JOIN price_lists t ON t.template = true JOIN price_list_service_levels s ON s.price_list_id = t.id WHERE c.template = false AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM price_list_service_levels x WHERE x.price_list_id = c.id); INSERT INTO price_list_delivery_methods (price_list_id, delivery_method, surcharge) SELECT c.id, d.delivery_method, d.surcharge FROM price_lists c JOIN price_lists t ON t.template = true JOIN price_list_delivery_methods d ON d.price_list_id = t.id WHERE c.template = false AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM price_list_delivery_methods x WHERE x.price_list_id = c.id);
